title: Plant Maintenance Microservice
goals: Provide a flat plant-maintenance domain foundation for equipment asset registration, preventive-maintenance plan approval, maintenance work-order release metadata, and work-order completion metadata.

Prepare ERP-grade SAP PM/EAM parity metadata without attaching durable asset persistence, IoT/SCADA ingestion, technician dispatch, spare-parts inventory reservation, procurement requisitions, accounting posting, Workflow execution, runtime audit-chain emission, or cloud deployment.
non_goals: No live enterprise asset management runtime, scheduling engine, technician mobile app, IoT/SCADA connector, spare-parts inventory mutation, procurement requisition creation, accounting posting, or predictive-maintenance model.
No durable persistence, warehouse mutation, supplier network call, plant safety permit execution, Workflow execution, runtime audit-chain emission, or cloud deployment.
No SAP, Oracle, or Dynamics plant-maintenance/enterprise-asset-management exhaustive parity claim.

acceptance_criteria.given: an equipment asset has tenant, legal entity, plant, functional location, criticality, installation/warranty dates, source refs, and registration evidence
acceptance_criteria.when: the plant-maintenance domain registers the equipment asset
acceptance_criteria.then: equipment, tenant, legal entity, plant, functional location, criticality, dates, source refs, registration evidence, idempotency key, state, schema version, and false durable-registry/IoT/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: a registered equipment asset needs scheduled preventive maintenance
acceptance_criteria.then: plan, equipment, tenant, legal entity, plant, functional location, interval, lead time, labor estimate, spare-part count, next due date, strategy source, approval evidence, idempotency key, state, and false scheduler/inventory/Workflow/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: an approved preventive-maintenance plan is ready for execution
acceptance_criteria.when: maintenance work-order release metadata is prepared
acceptance_criteria.then: work order, plan, equipment, tenant, legal entity, plant, functional location, priority, planned start, labor/spare-part plan, safety permit flag, job instruction source, release evidence, idempotency key, state, and false inventory/procurement/technician-dispatch/Workflow/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: a released maintenance work order has completion evidence and measured labor/spare/downtime values
acceptance_criteria.then: work order, equipment, tenant, legal entity, plant, completion date, planned/actual labor, labor variance, planned/actual spare parts, remaining spare parts, downtime, measurement/completion evidence, recalculation flag, and false accounting/meter-write/runtime-audit/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: untrusted identifiers, source refs, evidence refs, dates, intervals, quantities, or overclaim paths enter the plant-maintenance domain
acceptance_criteria.then: prefix-only identifiers, path traversal, whitespace/control characters, credential-shaped refs, invalid dates, warranty dates before installation, invalid preventive intervals, zero labor/spare quantities, missing equipment registration, missing plan approval, missing work-order release, and spare-part over-consumption are refused

decision_log.decision: Plant Maintenance enters the enterprise microservice set as a flat enterprise-asset-maintenance domain crate rather than a monolithic ERP/PM module; SAP PM/EAM and broader ERP maintenance coverage is mapped through Enterprise Suite parity composition while scheduling runtime, IoT ingestion, technician dispatch, spare-parts inventory, procurement requisitions, accounting posting, Workflow execution, runtime audit emission, and cloud deployment remain explicit non-claims.
